checks: first shield creation creates its meter at the current frame, with no future state leaked
shield creation, hit loss and silent expiry update the visible snapshot and remove the meter
read-only inspections return defensive copies and live notifications while the fight keeps playing
hidden and pagehide preserve pending frames, and returning never jumps to the result
manual pause survives backgrounding and shield/status snapshots do not advance until resume
a shield gained after a burst stays hidden until the final impact and follows its paused clock
an action completed while backgrounded starts its first visible frame only after returning
silent expiry metadata updates the view without adding a new message or delaying the next action
a status-only effect on an enemy never presents that recipient as the current turn
final boss initialization is captured before return; every opening preview preserves saved bytes
native shield skill and round-end expiry serialize display metadata without adding combat log rows
native status application keeps the actual caster, recipient and source card distinct
